project_info.theme: Techcombank FIFA World Cup 2026 emotional football story
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, stadium green, red, white, black

main_subject.detail: A cinematic football poster with the Techcombank logo at top right. Large headline reads 'DOI THU TREN SAN TRI KI NGOAI DOI'. Two male footballers embrace gently at center field after a match, one in a red jersey with a dark blue cross-like pattern and number 9, the other in a white jersey with red accents and number 10. A translucent Techcombank diamond shape overlays the stadium background. Bottom copy reads 'TECHCOMBANK & HE SINH THAI DONG HANH CUNG VTV thuc hien su menh phung su Quoc gia mang FIFA WORLD CUP 2026 TM Den trieu trieu trai tim Viet Nam' and the slogan 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY'.
main_subject.style: Emotion-driven sports brand poster with realistic football photography, national-broadcast mood, and subtle translucent brand geometry

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Techcombank football brand campaign. Background is a packed football stadium under bright blue sky with a translucent Techcombank diamond overlay. Surrounding elements: headline 'DOI THU TREN SAN TRI KI NGOAI DOI', Techcombank logo, bottom copy mentioning 'TECHCOMBANK & HE SINH THAI DONG HANH CUNG VTV' and 'FIFA WORLD CUP 2026', plus the slogan 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY'. Technical style: photo-real sports brand poster with cinematic compositing, bright stadium daylight, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
